access.entry: DOM __reactFiber$* / __reactContainer$* -> fiber child/sibling -> memoizedProps/pendingProps -> deep find of object containing workspaceScopedServices
access.workspace_scope: the workspace currently open in the app; CLI never switches or opens workspaces

chat list.returns: array<{sessionId:string, title:string, titleSource:string, status:string, mode:string, sessionKind:string, traceId:string, createdAt:epochMs, updatedAt:epochMs, workspace?:string}>

chat show.messageLimit: omitted for --all; default tail page otherwise
chat show.note: zcodeSessionService.readSession rejects inactive history with -32004 'Session is not active'; getTaskSnapshot works for history and is used instead

returns.meta: {taskId, traceId, title, titleOverridden, workspacePath, createdAt, updatedAt, mode, model, provider, status, target}
returns.messages: chronological; user and assistant share a turnIndex
returns.assistant_message: {id, role:'assistant', content:string(visible merged text), thought:string(hidden), parts:[{type:'thought'|'content'|'tool-call', content?}], tools, timestamp, durationMs, model, turnIndex}
returns.runtime.pendingPermissions: non-empty means blocked on user approval

envelope_common.commandId: fresh unique id generated by the CLI
envelope_common.clientId: MUST equal the renderer conversation client id from localStorage 'zcode-v4-client-id:v1'; invented id -> fault.command.clientMismatch
envelope_common.baseRevision: only for CAS commands; not used
envelope_common.baseLogEpoch: only for row-target commands; not used

create.config: omitted so workspace real defaults apply

send.sessionId: native session id from create or chat list

write.ack_meaning: accepted only means the command was queued; it does NOT contain the final reply

reply_collection.success_when: a user message with the exact prompt and turnIndex>=target exists and an assistant message with that turnIndex has non-empty visible text and meta.status is not running/paused
